title: Daily security log review and an AIDE change
caption: docs/mvp/deployment-single-vm.md §12; deploy/scripts/log-review.sh and ship-logs.sh.

steps.title: Read the daily summary
steps.body: E-mail `security log review <date>: …` (first run at or after 06:00 UTC).
steps.expect: Shipment status, SSH logins by user/source/method, sudo, auditd keys, AIDE's last check and age, WAF matches, airline-card route errors, egress refusals, fail2ban, app security events.

steps.title: Check the shipment
steps.expect: Last verified shipment under two hours old; cursor moving.

steps.title: Explain an AIDE change
steps.body: `security alert: AIDE found changes outside a deploy`: read `/var/log/aide/aide.log`, `/var/log/dpkg.log`, `ausearch -k velexis-aide`.
steps.expect: Every entry explained (package update, your own change) or treated as an incident.

steps.title: Re-baseline by hand
steps.body: After review, the manual re-baseline of deployment §12 (adds a `manual` line to `/var/lib/velexis/provision/aide-rebaseline`).
steps.expect: `check-vm.sh --only system` PASS for the database's SHA-256.

steps.title: Read logs off the VM
steps.body: On a machine with the data key: `age -d -i velexis-data.key <chunk> | zstdcat | jq`. On the VM: `sudo zstdcat /var/log/velexis/security/security-<day>.jsonl.zst | jq 'select(.cat == "ssh")'`.
steps.expect: No `[uri]` query value, no secret in any line.
